_note: Chapter 04 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The patient's abnormal breathing worried the doctor.
ex.cn: 病人反常的呼吸让医生很担心。
ex.note: abnormal behaviour 异常行为；abnormal for sb. 对某人来说反常

ex.en: We spent very little, and accordingly we had enough to spare.
ex.cn: 我们花得很少，因此手头还有富余。
ex.note: accordingly = therefore 因此；相应地

ex.en: In addition to the rent, we had to pay for the electricity.
ex.cn: 除了房租，我们还得付电费。
ex.note: in addition to 除…之外（还有）；an addition to 对…的增添

ex.en: The reading room is almost empty in the afternoon.
ex.cn: 阅览室下午几乎没什么人。
ex.note: in the afternoon 在下午；this afternoon 今天下午；afternoon tea 下午茶

ex.en: The old man lived alone in a small house near the sea.
ex.cn: 那位老人独自住在海边一间小屋里。
ex.note: leave sb. alone 别去打扰某人；be alone with 与…独处

ex.en: They visited an ancient temple at the edge of the city.
ex.cn: 他们参观了城市边缘一座古老的寺庙。
ex.note: ancient times 古代；ancient history 古代史

ex.en: He apologized to his roommate for coming home so late.
ex.cn: 他为自己的回来太晚向室友道了歉。
ex.note: apologize to sb. for sth. 为某事向某人道歉

ex.en: They had a long argument about where to meet.
ex.cn: 他们为在哪里见面争论了很久。
ex.note: an argument with sb. 与某人的争执；an argument for/against 支持/反对…的论据

ex.en: The writing assignment is due on Friday.
ex.cn: 这份写作作业周五截止。
ex.note: a writing assignment 一份写作作业；on assignment 外派执行任务

ex.en: The students practiced the dialogue in the audio lab.
ex.cn: 学生们在语音实验室里练习那段对话。
ex.note: audio lab 语音实验室；audio equipment 音频设备

ex.en: Every Sunday his mother bakes a loaf of brown bread.
ex.cn: 每个星期天，母亲都会烤一条黑面包。
ex.note: bake bread 烤面包；baked potatoes 烤土豆

ex.en: He plays basketball for the school team every Saturday.
ex.cn: 他每周六都代表校队打篮球。
ex.note: play basketball 打篮球；a basketball match 篮球比赛

ex.en: On behalf of the whole class, he thanked the teacher.
ex.cn: 他代表全班同学向老师道了谢。
ex.note: on behalf of sb. 代表某人；in behalf of 为了…的利益

ex.en: The new library cost more than a billion yuan.
ex.cn: 这座新图书馆耗资超过十亿元。
ex.note: a billion people 十亿人；billions of 数十亿

ex.en: The board of directors approved the new plan.
ex.cn: 董事会批准了这项新计划。
ex.note: on the board 董事会成员；a board member 董事

ex.en: They boarded the bus at the corner and rode to the harbour.
ex.cn: 他们在街角上了公交，一路坐到港口。
ex.note: board a plane/boat 登机/上船；board at a hotel 在旅馆住宿

ex.en: He kept all his coins in a small wooden box.
ex.cn: 他把他所有的硬币都收在一个小木盒里。
ex.note: a cardboard box 纸箱；box office 售票处

ex.en: She used a soft brush to paint the edge of the box.
ex.cn: 她用一把柔软的刷子给箱子的边缘上漆。
ex.note: a paint brush 画笔；a toothbrush 牙刷

ex.en: He brushed his teeth before going to bed every night.
ex.cn: 他每天睡前都刷牙。
ex.note: brush one's teeth 刷牙；brush sb. off 敷衍某人

ex.en: We met at a small cafe near the campus gate.
ex.cn: 我们在校园门口附近的一家小咖啡馆见了面。
ex.note: a campus cafe 校园咖啡馆；internet cafe 网吧

ex.en: He paid for the ticket with a bank card.
ex.cn: 他用银行卡买了票。
ex.note: a credit card 信用卡；a playing card 一张扑克牌；on one's card 名列…之中

ex.en: The noise ceased at last, and the street fell silent.
ex.cn: 噪音终于停了，街道安静下来。
ex.note: cease doing 停止做；cease to do 停止做；not cease to be 依旧是

ex.en: Patience is the most noticeable characteristic of a good teacher.
ex.cn: 耐心是一位好老师最明显的特征。
ex.note: a characteristic of … …的特征；by characteristic 凭特性

ex.en: It is quite characteristic of my sister to forget her keys.
ex.cn: 我妹妹忘带钥匙是常有的事。
ex.note: be characteristic of sb. 是某人的特点

ex.en: He ordered a cup of coffee and a plate of chips.
ex.cn: 他点了一杯咖啡和一盘薯条。
ex.note: a packet of chips 一袋薯条；potato chips 薯片

ex.en: He chipped the edge of the cup when he dropped it.
ex.cn: 杯子掉在地上时磕掉了一个口。
ex.note: chip away at 一点一点地啃；a chipped tooth 崩了角的牙

ex.en: The contract had a single clause about the working hours.
ex.cn: 合同里关于工作时间只有一条款。
ex.note: a clause in the contract 合同中的一条；a relative clause 关系从句

ex.en: She drinks a cup of coffee before every exam.
ex.cn: 她每次考试前都要喝一杯咖啡。
ex.note: black coffee 黑咖啡；coffee break 咖啡小憩

ex.en: Tutoring twice a week was a real commitment for him.
ex.cn: 每周两次家教对他来说是一份实在的承诺。
ex.note: a commitment to sth. 对某事的投入；make a commitment 作出承诺

ex.en: The teacher wrote a comprehensive report on the experiment.
ex.cn: 老师就这次实验写了一份全面的报告。
ex.note: a comprehensive survey 全面的调查；comprehensive coverage 全面覆盖

ex.en: We must confront the problem instead of avoiding it.
ex.cn: 我们必须面对这个问题，而不是回避它。
ex.note: confront sb. with sth. 使某人面临某事；be confronted with 面临

ex.en: The old engine consumes far more fuel than the new one.
ex.cn: 那台旧机器耗油比新的多得多。
ex.note: consume energy 消耗能源；consume a lot of time 耗费大量时间

ex.en: He cooked dinner for his roommate and two friends.
ex.cn: 他给室友和两个朋友做了晚饭。
ex.note: cook up 迅速编出；cook sth. up 想出（一个借口）

ex.en: The head cook has worked in the restaurant for twenty years.
ex.cn: 那位主厨在这家餐馆干了二十年。
ex.note: a head cook 主厨；a camp cook 炊事员

ex.en: After four years abroad, he returned to his own country.
ex.cn: 在国外待了四年后，他回到了自己的国家。
ex.note: in the country 在乡下；developing country 发展中国家；country music 乡村音乐

ex.en: The country is facing its worst economic crisis in a decade.
ex.cn: 这个国家正面临十年来最严重的经济危机。
ex.note: a financial crisis 金融危机；in crisis 处于危机之中

ex.en: He cursed under his breath when his phone fell into the water.
ex.cn: 手机掉进水里时，他低声咒骂了一句。
ex.note: curse sb. 咒骂某人；a curse on … …的祸根；curse the weather 骂天气

ex.en: The deadline for the essay is Friday morning.
ex.cn: 这篇文章的截止时间是周五上午。
ex.note: meet a deadline 赶上截止日期；the deadline for … …的截止时间

ex.en: He had to defend his argument in front of the whole class.
ex.cn: 他不得不当着全班为自己的论点辩护。
ex.note: defend sb. against sth. 保护某人免受…；defend one's position 捍卫立场

ex.en: The depth of the lake made the water look almost black.
ex.cn: 湖水很深，看上去几乎是黑的。
ex.note: in the depth of winter 在隆冬时节；the depth of one's feelings 感情的深度

ex.en: Two tests were needed to diagnose the infection.
ex.cn: 要诊断这种感染，需要做两项检查。
ex.note: be diagnosed with 被诊断出患有…；diagnose sb. as having sth. 诊断某人患有…

ex.en: She is the director of the language centre.
ex.cn: 她是语言中心的主任。
ex.note: a film director 电影导演；on the board of directors 担任董事

ex.en: Please dispose of the waste paper before Friday.
ex.cn: 请在周五之前把废纸处理掉。
ex.note: dispose of 处理掉；dispose sb. to sth. 使某人倾向于…

ex.en: Rice is the dominant crop in the south of the country.
ex.cn: 水稻是这个国家南方最主要的作物。
ex.note: be dominant in 在…中占主导地位；a dominant figure 举足轻重的人物

ex.en: A fire drill was held in the hall on Monday morning.
ex.cn: 周一上午，礼堂里举行了一次消防演习。
ex.note: a fire drill 消防演习；a drilling team 钻井队

ex.en: They drilled the same pass a hundred times until it became a habit.
ex.cn: 他们把同一套配合练了上百遍，直到它变成习惯。
ex.note: drill sb. in sth. 操练某人做某事；drill holes 钻孔

ex.en: He got up early every day to catch the first bus.
ex.cn: 他每天早早就起床，好赶上第一班公交。
ex.note: early in the morning 清晨；early on 起初；an early start 提早出发

ex.en: The bus was eight minutes late every morning.
ex.cn: 那趟公交每天早上都晚八分钟。
ex.note: eight o'clock 八点；eighty per cent 百分之八十

ex.en: Many young people emigrate abroad to look for better work.
ex.cn: 许多年轻人移居国外，寻找更好的工作。
ex.note: emigrate from/to 从…移居到…；emigrate to Canada 移居加拿大

ex.en: He enlarged the photograph so that everyone could see it.
ex.cn: 他把照片放大了些，好让每个人都能看清。
ex.note: enlarge a photo 放大照片；enlarge the capacity 扩大容量

ex.en: Sleep is essential to good health.
ex.cn: 睡眠对健康是必不可少的。
ex.note: be essential to/for 对…必不可少；essential elements 必要成分

ex.en: Her bag held all the essentials for a long journey.
ex.cn: 她的包里装着长途旅行的必需品。
ex.note: the essentials 必需品；an essential part 必需的部分

ex.en: Her savings will not exceed a hundred yuan.
ex.cn: 她的存款不会超过一百元。
ex.note: exceed the limit 超出限度；exceed one's expectations 超出某人的意料

ex.en: Could you explain how the machine works?
ex.cn: 你能讲讲这台机器是怎么运转的吗？
ex.note: explain sth. to sb. 向某人解释某事；explain oneself 解释清楚

ex.en: The failure of the machine was caused by a loose cable.
ex.cn: 机器出故障是因为一根电缆松了。
ex.note: a failure to do 未能做…；failure rate 故障率

ex.en: The wound was not fatal, but it needed careful treatment.
ex.cn: 这伤并不致命，但需要精心处理。
ex.note: a fatal illness 绝症；fatal for 对…致命

ex.en: Few people knew how hard the work really was.
ex.cn: 很少有人知道这份工作究竟有多辛苦。
ex.note: a few 一些；the few 少数人；few and far between 寥寥无几

ex.en: The shop opens at five and closes at nine.
ex.cn: 这家店五点开门，九点关门。
ex.note: five o'clock 五点；in fives 五个一组

ex.en: His grandmother was fond of the sea and of long walks.
ex.cn: 他的祖母喜欢大海，也喜欢长途散步。
ex.note: be fond of 喜爱；be fond of doing 喜欢做

ex.en: The train was forty minutes late that morning.
ex.cn: 那天早上火车晚点了四十分钟。
ex.note: forty degrees 四十度；the forties 四十年代

ex.en: The fruit in that shop is always fresh and cheap.
ex.cn: 那家店的水果总是又新鲜又便宜。
ex.note: fresh fruit 新鲜水果；the fruit of one's labour 劳动成果；bear fruit 结实

ex.en: She put two cloves of garlic into the soup.
ex.cn: 她往汤里放了两瓣大蒜。
ex.note: a clove of garlic 一瓣大蒜；garlic bread 蒜香面包

ex.en: He poured a glass of milk and drank it quickly.
ex.cn: 他倒了一杯牛奶，一口气喝完。
ex.note: a glass of water 一杯水；a glass door 玻璃门；wear glasses 戴眼镜

ex.en: His English grade improved by ten points this term.
ex.cn: 这学期他的英语成绩提高了十分。
ex.note: a good/bad grade 好/差成绩；grade school 小学；in the ninth grade 在九年级

ex.en: The teacher graded the essays over the weekend.
ex.cn: 老师周末批改了这些文章。
ex.note: grade papers 批改试卷；be graded by 被打分

ex.en: The grocer weighed the rice and wrote the price on the bag.
ex.cn: 杂货商称了米，把价钱写在袋子上。
ex.note: the grocer's 杂货店；a local grocer 本地杂货商

ex.en: He held a handful of sand and let it run through his fingers.
ex.cn: 他抓了一把沙子，任它从指缝间漏下去。
ex.note: a handful of 一把；少量；take a handful of 抓一把

ex.en: The story made the front page under a bold headline.
ex.cn: 这则报道以醒目的标题登上了头版。
ex.note: make the headlines 成为头条新闻；a headline figure 关键数字

ex.en: This cup is hers, and that one is mine.
ex.cn: 这只杯子是她的，那只是我的。
ex.note: his and hers 他的和她的；the book is hers 这本书是她的

ex.en: We trust him because of his honesty and his patience.
ex.cn: 我们信任他，因为他的正直和耐心。
ex.note: in all honesty 老实说；question sb.'s honesty 怀疑某人的诚实

ex.en: The summer here is hot and humid.
ex.cn: 这里的夏天又热又潮。
ex.note: hot and humid 又热又潮湿；a humid climate 潮湿的气候

ex.en: The book is full of colour illustrations of the harbour.
ex.cn: 书里满是港口的彩色插图。
ex.note: an illustration of … …的插图；by illustration 举例说明

ex.en: The road inclines gently towards the river.
ex.cn: 这条路缓缓地朝河边倾斜。
ex.note: incline sb. to sth. 使某人倾向于…；be inclined to do 倾向于做

ex.en: The bus struggled up the steep incline.
ex.cn: 公交车吃力地爬上了那道陡坡。
ex.note: a steep incline 陡坡；an inclined plane 斜面

ex.en: The librarian printed out the information he needed.
ex.cn: 图书管理员把他需要的资料打印了出来。
ex.note: a piece of information 一条信息；information on/about 关于…的信息

ex.en: The nurse instructed him to rest for three days.
ex.cn: 护士嘱咐他休息三天。
ex.note: instruct sb. to do sth. 指示某人做某事；instructed in 讲授…课程

ex.en: The introduction of the book explains the author's plan.
ex.cn: 这本书的前言说明了作者的写作计划。
ex.note: an introduction to … …的介绍；the introduction of A into B A的引进

ex.en: She wore a small jewel on a thin silver chain.
ex.cn: 她在一条细细的银链上挂了一颗小小的宝石。
ex.note: a jewel of a teapot 一件小巧精致的茶壶；jewels and pearls 珠宝首饰

ex.en: The kids were playing football in the yard.
ex.cn: 孩子们在院子里踢足球。
ex.note: the kids 孩子们；a kid of my age 我这个年纪的孩子

ex.en: Are you kidding me? That cannot be true.
ex.cn: 你在开玩笑吧？这不可能是真的。
ex.note: kid sb. about sth. 就某事戏弄某人；kid yourself 别开玩笑了

ex.en: The landlord raised the rent by twenty yuan a month.
ex.cn: 房东把房租每月涨了二十元。
ex.note: the landlord 房东；landlord and tenant 房东与租客

ex.en: Their team won the city league last spring.
ex.cn: 他们的球队去年春天夺得了市联赛冠军。
ex.note: the city league 市联赛；in league with 与…结盟

ex.en: He spent the whole afternoon in the library.
ex.cn: 他在图书馆里待了整个下午。
ex.note: a lending library 外借图书馆；a library card 借书证

ex.en: The doctor pressed gently on his liver.
ex.cn: 医生轻轻按了按他的肝脏。
ex.note: a liver complaint 肝脏疾病；liver cancer 肝癌

ex.en: He felt low after the exam and went for a long walk.
ex.cn: 考试之后他情绪低落，散了很久的步。
ex.note: in low spirits 情绪低落；be low on sth. 缺少某物；a low voice 低声

ex.en: The male birds have brighter feathers than the females.
ex.cn: 雄鸟的羽毛比雌鸟鲜艳。
ex.note: male and female 雄性与雌性；a male student 男学生

ex.en: The survey included two hundred males and three hundred females.
ex.cn: 这次调查包括两百名男性和三百名女性。
ex.note: a male adult 成年男性；male nurses 男护士

ex.en: It is only a matter of time before the application is accepted.
ex.cn: 申请被接受只是时间问题。
ex.note: a matter of … …的问题；no matter 不要紧；a matter of fact 事实问题

ex.en: It hardly matters if we arrive ten minutes late.
ex.cn: 我们晚到十分钟也无关紧要。
ex.note: It doesn't matter 不要紧；matter to sb. 对某人重要

ex.en: He has a very good memory for names.
ex.cn: 他记名字的本事很好。
ex.note: in memory of 纪念；a good memory for 对…有很好的记性；memory card 存储卡

ex.en: He tried to keep the cost at a minimum.
ex.cn: 他尽量把开销压到最低。
ex.note: at a minimum 至少；a minimum of 两小时；the minimum wage 最低工资

ex.en: The minimum age for the job is eighteen.
ex.cn: 这份工作的最低年龄限制是十八岁。
ex.note: a minimum of 至少；minimum requirements 最低要求

ex.en: He saved enough money to buy a second-hand bicycle.
ex.cn: 他攒够了钱，买一辆二手自行车。
ex.note: make money 赚钱；a money order 汇票；get money for nothing 得不偿失

ex.en: The rain turned the path into mud.
ex.cn: 雨水把小路变成了泥浆。
ex.note: covered in mud 满是泥；mud bricks 土坯；stick in the mud 陷入困境

ex.en: His father served in the navy for twenty years.
ex.cn: 他父亲在海军服役了二十年。
ex.note: the navy 海军；join the navy 加入海军；navy blue 藏青色

ex.en: The next chapter is about the first exams.
ex.cn: 下一章讲的是第一次考试。
ex.note: the next day 第二天；next to 紧挨着；next week 下周

ex.en: I did not notice the change in the weather until noon.
ex.cn: 直到中午我才注意到天气变了。
ex.note: notice sb. do sth. 注意到某人做某事；without notice 不打招呼

ex.en: A notice about the inspection was pinned on the board.
ex.cn: 关于检查的通知钉在布告板上。
ex.note: on the notice board 在布告栏上；give notice 通知；at short notice 临时

ex.en: He wore a blue shirt for the occasion.
ex.cn: 为这个场合，他穿了一件蓝衬衫。
ex.note: on this particular occasion 在这个特定场合；on occasion 偶尔

ex.en: The cat jumped onto the shelf above the desk.
ex.cn: 猫跳到了书桌上方的搁板上。
ex.note: onto 多接动词，强调动作的结果位置；on 多接状态

ex.en: Leave now, otherwise you will miss the last bus.
ex.cn: 现在就走吧，否则你会错过末班车。
ex.note: otherwise = or else 否则；in other words 换句话说

ex.en: The owner of the cafe knows every student by name.
ex.cn: 咖啡馆的老板认识每一个学生的名字。
ex.note: the owner of … …的所有者；a joint owner 共同所有者

ex.en: His parents sent him money at the beginning of every month.
ex.cn: 父母每月月初都给他寄钱。
ex.note: single parent 单亲家长；a parent company 母公司

ex.en: The payment for the job was small but steady.
ex.cn: 这份工作的报酬不多，但很稳定。
ex.note: a monthly payment 每月付款；payment for … …的报酬；in payment for 作为…的报酬

ex.en: Smoking is not permitted anywhere in the building.
ex.cn: 楼里任何地方都禁止吸烟。
ex.note: permit sb. to do sth. 允许某人做某事；permit of 允许…

ex.en: He applied for a work permit before leaving the country.
ex.cn: 他出国前申请了工作许可。
ex.note: a parking permit 停车许可证；work permit 工作许可

ex.en: A pig was sleeping under the old wooden cart.
ex.cn: 一头猪在旧木车底下睡着了。
ex.note: a pigsty 猪圈；the pigs of the market 唯利是图的人；go hog 激动

ex.en: Rain was plentiful during the monsoon season.
ex.cn: 季风季节的雨水十分充沛。
ex.note: plentiful supplies 充足的供给；be plentiful in 富含…

ex.en: This song is popular with students everywhere.
ex.cn: 这首歌在各地的学生中都很受欢迎。
ex.note: be popular with/among 受…欢迎；popular belief 普遍的看法

ex.en: The old building lost its power for two hours.
ex.cn: 那栋楼停电了两个小时。
ex.note: have the power to do 有权做…；the power of music 音乐的力量；a power plant 发电厂

ex.en: Regular exercise helps prevent many illnesses.
ex.cn: 经常锻炼有助于预防许多疾病。
ex.note: prevent sb. from doing 阻止某人做；prevent sth. from happening 防止…发生

ex.en: We had a productive meeting and settled several problems.
ex.cn: 我们开了一次很有成效的会议，解决了几个问题。
ex.note: a productive day 收获颇丰的一天；highly productive 效率很高的

ex.en: The cafe provides free tea to its student workers.
ex.cn: 咖啡馆给它的学生雇员提供免费茶水。
ex.note: provide sb. with sth. 为某人提供某物；provide for 供养；provide that 规定

ex.en: This shop sells cloth of the highest quality.
ex.cn: 这家店出售质量最好的布料。
ex.note: of high quality 质量好的；the quality of life 生活品质

ex.en: It is rare to find such a kind old man.
ex.cn: 这样的好老人很少见。
ex.note: rarely 很少；a rare chance 难得的机会；rarely heard of 鲜为人知

ex.en: I have not seen him recently.
ex.cn: 我最近没见到他。
ex.note: until recently 直到最近；recently added 最近新增的

ex.en: Most students in this region come from small towns.
ex.cn: 这一地区的大部分学生都来自小镇。
ex.note: in the region 在该地区；the region of … …的范围；a rural region 农村地区

ex.en: They drove to a remote village at the foot of the hills.
ex.cn: 他们开车去了山脚下一个偏僻的村庄。
ex.note: remote control 遥控器；remote from 远离；a remote area 偏远地区

ex.en: His resistance to all advice made his parents worry.
ex.cn: 他对一切劝告的抵触让父母很担心。
ex.note: resistance to 对…的抵抗；high resistance 高电阻；a resistance fighter 抵抗战士

ex.en: A ribbon of blue silk hung from her hair.
ex.cn: 一条蓝色丝带从她的头发上垂下来。
ex.note: a ribbon of 一条…带；tie sth. with a ribbon 用丝带系住某物

ex.en: They tied the boat to the tree with a thick rope.
ex.cn: 他们用一根粗绳把船绑在树上。
ex.note: a rope bridge 绳桥；tie a knot 打结；a rope ladder 绳梯

ex.en: His grandfather was a sailor on a small coastal ship.
ex.cn: 他的祖父曾是一艘小型近海船上的水手。
ex.note: a merchant sailor 商船船员；a sailor hat 水手帽

ex.en: The sudden noise scared the children.
ex.cn: 突如其来的声响吓到了孩子们。
ex.note: scare sb. stiff 吓得某人发僵；be scared of 害怕

ex.en: The warning caused a scare in the village.
ex.cn: 这个警报在村里引起了恐慌。
ex.note: a false alarm 虚惊一场；cause a scare 引起恐慌

ex.en: The main problem is the cost; everything else is secondary.
ex.cn: 主要问题是成本，其他的都是次要的。
ex.note: secondary school 中学；be secondary to 次于；of secondary importance 次要

ex.en: She had a serious talk with her son about his studies.
ex.cn: 她就儿子的学习跟他谈了一次，语气很严肃。
ex.note: serious about 对…认真；a serious illness 重病；look serious 看起来很严重

ex.en: The old dictionary sat on the top shelf of the desk.
ex.cn: 那本旧字典放在书桌最上层的搁板上。
ex.note: on the top shelf 在最高层；a shelf life 保质期

ex.en: The sight of the harbour took his breath away.
ex.cn: 港口的景象让他屏住了呼吸。
ex.note: at first sight 一见之下；catch sight of 瞥见；lose sight of 看不见

ex.en: Sixty students signed up for the optional course.
ex.cn: 有六十名学生报名了选修课。
ex.note: sixty per cent 百分之六十；in the sixties 六十年代

ex.en: He gave up smoking after the cough lasted a month.
ex.cn: 咳了一个月之后，他戒烟了。
ex.note: give up smoking 戒烟；a smoke alarm 烟雾报警器

ex.en: They smoked the meat over a low fire.
ex.cn: 他们用小火把肉熏了。
ex.note: be smoked 用烟熏制；smoke cigars 抽雪茄；smoke like a chimney 烟瘾极大

ex.en: There is something wrong with this plan.
ex.cn: 这个计划有些不对劲。
ex.note: something to drink 喝点什么；something like 有点像

ex.en: She is a specialist in medieval history.
ex.cn: 她是中世纪史方面的专家。
ex.note: a specialist in … …的专家；an eye specialist 眼科专家

ex.en: There was a small spot of oil on the page.
ex.cn: 纸上有一小块油渍。
ex.note: a spot of rain 几点雨；on the spot 立刻；a hot spot 热点

ex.en: I spotted my old bag on the third shelf.
ex.cn: 我在第三层搁板上认出了我那个旧包。
ex.note: spot sb. doing sth. 发现某人在做某事；spot the difference 找出不同

ex.en: His income has been steady for three years.
ex.cn: 他的收入三年以来一直很稳定。
ex.note: a steady hand 稳健的手法；steady progress 稳步进展；keep a steady pace 保持稳定的节奏

ex.en: It felt strange to be alone in the big old house.
ex.cn: 独自待在那栋又大又老的房子里，感觉很奇怪。
ex.note: feel strange 觉得奇怪；strange to sb. 对某人来说陌生；a strange accent 奇怪的口音

ex.en: The medicine contains a strong substance that kills the bacteria.
ex.cn: 这种药含有一种能杀死细菌的强效成分。
ex.note: a chemical substance 化学物质；the substance of the matter 事情的实质

ex.en: They climbed the hill to watch the sunrise.
ex.cn: 他们爬上山去看日出。
ex.note: at sunrise 日出时分；before sunrise 日出之前

ex.en: I swear that I have never taken the money.
ex.cn: 我发誓自己从没拿过那笔钱。
ex.note: swear to do sth. 发誓做某事；swear at sb. 咒骂某人；swear by 极其信奉

ex.en: She put a piece of tape over the name on the box.
ex.cn: 她用一小段胶带把盒子上的名字盖住了。
ex.note: a roll of tape 一卷胶带；a tape measure 软尺；video tape 录像带

ex.en: He taped the lecture and listened to it twice.
ex.cn: 他把讲座录了下来，听了两遍。
ex.note: tape a conversation 录下谈话；tape sth. to sth. 用胶带把…粘在…上

ex.en: He spoke to the child in a tender voice.
ex.cn: 他用温柔的声音对那孩子说话。
ex.note: a tender heart 柔软的心肠；tender skin 柔嫩的皮肤；at a tender age 在年纪尚幼时

ex.en: The road was closed; therefore we took the long way round.
ex.cn: 路封了，因此我们绕了远路。
ex.note: therefore = for this reason 因此；and therefore 因此

ex.en: Do not throw stones at the birds.
ex.cn: 不要朝鸟扔石头。
ex.note: throw away 扔掉；throw oneself into 全力投入；a throw of the dice 碰运气

ex.en: The nearest toilet is at the end of the corridor.
ex.cn: 最近的卫生间在走廊尽头。
ex.note: go to the toilet 去洗手间；a public toilet 公共厕所

ex.en: The old market is famous for its traditional food.
ex.cn: 那个老市场以传统小吃闻名。
ex.note: traditional culture 传统文化；traditional Chinese medicine 中医

ex.en: He learned a few tricks for making cheap meals taste good.
ex.cn: 他学了几招让便宜的饭菜变好吃的窍门。
ex.note: a trick of the trade 业内窍门；trick sb. into sth. 骗某人相信某事

ex.en: He tricked his little sister into eating her vegetables.
ex.cn: 他哄着妹妹把蔬菜吃了。
ex.note: trick sb. into doing sth. 骗某人做某事；trick sb. into sth. 骗某人相信某事

ex.en: This is a typical question in the exam.
ex.cn: 这是考试中的典型问题。
ex.note: be typical of … 是…的典型；a typical example 典型的例子

ex.en: He wanted to study the universe when he was a boy.
ex.cn: 他小时候想研究宇宙。
ex.note: the universe 宇宙；the whole universe 整个宇宙

ex.en: There were several vacant rooms in the hotel.
ex.cn: 旅馆里有几间空房。
ex.note: a vacant position 空缺职位；vacant eyes 茫然的眼神；become vacant 空出来

ex.en: He watched a short video about the experiment.
ex.cn: 他看了一段关于这个实验的短视频。
ex.note: a video camera 摄像机；a video game 电子游戏；video tape 录像带

ex.en: Attendance at the lecture is voluntary.
ex.cn: 这场讲座自愿参加。
ex.note: voluntary service 志愿服务；voluntary work 志愿工作；voluntary retirement 自愿退休

ex.en: Everyone knows his weakness for sweet food.
ex.cn: 人人都知道他贪嘴的毛病。
ex.note: a weakness for 对…的嗜好；show one's weakness 暴露弱点

ex.en: A bicycle wheel needs oil every few months.
ex.cn: 自行车轮子每隔几个月就要上油。
ex.note: a steering wheel 方向盘；wheel and axle 轮轴；at the wheel 掌权

ex.en: Their team won the final by two points.
ex.cn: 他们队以两分优势赢得了决赛。
ex.note: win a prize 获奖；win the game 赢下比赛；a winning streak 连胜

ex.en: The match was a great win for the visitors.
ex.cn: 这场比赛对客队来说是一场大胜。
ex.note: a big win 大胜；a win for sb. 对某人来说是个胜利

ex.en: The company sells its products worldwide.
ex.cn: 这家公司把产品销往世界各地。
ex.note: worldwide sales 全球销售额；a worldwide reputation 世界声誉

ex.en: The field yielded a good crop of rice that year.
ex.cn: 那年田里产出了一批好稻米。
ex.note: yield to sb. 向某人让步；yield to pressure 屈从压力；yield a result 产生结果

ex.en: The yield of wheat doubled after the new seed was used.
ex.cn: 换上新种子后，小麦的产量翻了一番。
ex.note: a high yield 高产量；yield per hectare 单位面积产量
